title: Ilizwi Elithuleyo Lentlambo
intro: Buyela umva kwixesha uye kubantu abanamandla abakhe bafumana ummangaliso ophilayo njengovavanyo. Ukuzikhukhumeza nokuqina kwentliziyo kwatywina ikamva labo. Ungalilandela ibali uze ufumane ukuba kwenzeka ntoni kweli xesha limangalisayo lokuguquka?
clues: Ndathunyelwa njengovavanyo oluvela kuThixo kubantu abanamandla abaziwayo ngamandla abo nokungavumi kwabo.
Ndandingummangaliso okhethekileyo—abantu abafana nam babengazange babonakale phakathi kwabo.
Ndabelana ngamanzi okusela avela emthonjeni nabantu bam ngeentsuku ezitshintshanayo.
Balunyukiswa ukuba naluphi na ulwaphulo-mthetho olujoliswe kum luya kuzisa isohlwayo esikhawulezileyo.
Abanesibindi kubo abazange basithobele eso silumkiso baza bandixaka.
Emva kokufa kwam, isikhalo esinye esikhulu esivela phezulu satshabalalisa bonke abantu bam.
verse: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her]. (54:29)
